seo.title: ODD — ODDfest, ODDference & ODDspace | Helsinki
seo.description: ODD builds events, spaces and projects that strengthen creative work and bring creative and cultural expertise closer to business and wider society.

hero.mosaicAlt: People, performances, talks and encounters from ODD in Helsinki.

opening.headline: ODD builds better conditions for creative work — and brings creative people, business and society closer together.

whatOddIs.headline: Finland has extraordinary creative talent. We build the places, events and connections that help creative work go further.
whatOddIs.body:
The talent is here. What is often missing are the connections around it: places to work, people to meet, partners to build with and routes to new opportunities.

ODD creates those connections through events, spaces and projects — helping creative work reach new audiences, find new partners and meet business, institutions and wider society.

twoWaysIn.intro: ODD connects and translates between creative fields, business and wider society.

creative.lede: Work, meet people and find collaborators.
creative.body: Work from ODDspace. Host an event at ODDfest. Meet people across disciplines and use the parts of ODD that are useful to your practice.

business.body: Come to ODDference, build a partnership or bring us a brief where cultural understanding and creative expertise matter.

proofIntro.headline: Two years in, this is what has already happened.
proofIntro.body: ODD began with the first ODDfest in 2025. Since then, ODDference and ODDspace have joined it, alongside project work with organisations. The figures below are cumulative across that work.

platforms.title: ODDfest
platforms.body: Helsinki’s creative week, bringing independent events, ideas and creative communities across the city together into one shared week.

platforms.title: ODDference
platforms.body: Where creative expertise meets business and society. Meet people across disciplines and explore what creative practice can teach us.

platforms.title: ODDspace
platforms.body: A year-round home for creative work — bringing workspace, studios, events and community under one roof.

workWithOdd.title: Work with ODD
workWithOdd.body: Bring us a question, brief, event or partnership idea. We build the right team, format and creative expertise around it.
